teams.name: Flower Sisters
teams.intro: They are not actually sisters in real life. But their synergy makes people wonder.

teams.name: WildFlowers
teams.intro:
- “Apparently because we have a habit of turning up where nobody planted us.”

  - “You’re all flower Guardians, but you're all different flowers… like the wildflowers near my house.”

  - “Command has its Guardians. The people have the Wildflowers.”
